needed.evidence: No footway present on the left side of the road, forcing pedestrians to walk in the carriageway.
needed.suggestion: Install a continuous, usable sidewalk along the left side of the road to provide a safe walking space for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: The narrow sidewalk on the right side is partly blocked by parked vehicles and other obstructions.
needed.suggestion: Remove obstructions and widen the sidewalk on the right side to ensure it is fully accessible and usable for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Uneven and broken sections on the narrow sidewalk create trip hazards.
needed.suggestion: Repair and resurface the sidewalk on the right side to eliminate trip hazards and ensure a smooth walking surface.

needed.evidence: There is no crossing facility despite the presence of pedestrians and crossing demand.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing at this location to provide a safe crossing point for pedestrians.
